meta.title: SmartQuiz Remote
meta.description: Phone remote access for DSH: LAN HTTP endpoint, device-token auth, pairing QR code, and CLI or in-process task execution.

panel.title: Phone remote
panel.hint: Phone: SmartQuiz → Tools → Remote connection (computer) → scan the code
panel.execAllowed: Allow the phone to run commands on this computer
panel.openPairing: Open the pairing page on this computer
panel.tunnelTitle: Public tunnel (optional; LAN works without it)
panel.meshDetected: This looks like a mesh (VPN) address, not a public tunnel; devices in the mesh can connect directly.
panel.tunnelHint: Fill this only for a real public/tunnel address. Mesh addresses such as Tailscale are detected as "Mesh (VPN)" automatically.
panel.qrHint: Scan with the phone to pair (QR generated by the server; no browser needed)
panel.codeHint: Issued by the computer and rotated every 30 seconds; enter it in the phone's pairing screen.
